item.description: A year after pulling its music in protest, the duo is back on Spotify. For Amelia Meath and Nick Sanborn, that journey has been frustrating, eye-opening — and full of smaller victories.

item.title: What the equinox 'henge' effect tells us about U.S. cities
item.description: The fall equinox, which arrives Tuesday in the U.S., brings shorter days, and chances to witness alignment between Earth and the sun. It's a modern version of ancient observances of a celestial shift.

item.title: Rhiannon Giddens' banjo connects her to her ancestors: 'The spirits come through'
item.description: A self-described "folkie to the bone," Giddens sings and plays banjo and fiddle in this interview. Her latest album, Hope Is the Thing with Feathers, takes its name from an Emily Dickinson poem.

item.title: Aviation regulators turn to AI to help manage the nation's airspace
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration launched an ambitious $875-million-dollar push to make the U.S. airspace more efficient. But critics say it won't solve bigger problems with air traffic control.

item.title: Paramount makes concessions to salvage $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal
item.description: Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that endangered the media company's bid for its larger Hollywood rival, Warner Bros. Discovery.

item.title: Many GOP candidates still echo Trump's 2020 claims. Lots of voters want to move on
item.description: While many Republican candidates, even in some critical tossup races, still back President Trump's baseless claims about election integrity, some GOP voters say they are ready to move on.

item.title: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
item.description: The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.
